body:
A concrete handoff for the still-unresolved **T100**: one denominator coefficient vanishes by a short physical-equation identity.

Write $D=\sum_i a_iD_i$ using raw E1 indices. Let $E_0,\ldots,E_{710}$ be the zero-based equations returned by [`typed100_continuation.build(model)`](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/aef80798e3c97c1b3d3a9440c3c6fc4ac084c8a6/experiments/typed100_continuation.py), before removing raw 56. Then

$$
\begin{aligned}
a_{56}^{3}={}&a_6\left(\frac{E_{22}}{12}-\frac{E_{93}+E_{94}+E_{112}}2+3E_{98}-\frac32E_{161}\right)\\
&+9a_{272}(E_{121}-E_{118})\\
&+a_{56}\left(\frac56E_{371}-5E_{416}-5E_{417}+3E_{421}-5E_{430}-15E_{459}+27E_{695}\right).
\end{aligned}
$$

This is `relations[107]` in the [immutable global packet](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/aef80798e3c97c1b3d3a9440c3c6fc4ac084c8a6/results/typed-rewrite-families/t100/global.json.gz): zero-based selected generator 24, or generator 6 in its pure $X_0$ block. Local denominator coordinates 0, 2, 10 mean raw 6, 56, 272. I re-expanded all 15 products using both physical reconstructions: **1,075 coefficient products per reconstruction**, exact `Fraction` arithmetic, PASS. Hence $a_{56}=0$ over $\mathbb C$.

The [rebuilt packet](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/aef80798e3c97c1b3d3a9440c3c6fc4ac084c8a6/results/typed-rewrite-families/t100/closure.json.gz) retains raw support $\lbrace6,42,88,102,111,114,135,211,235,272,289,293\rbrace$: 706 equations with all 128 stabilizer-compatible Koszul corrections. Both normalized charts $a_6=1$ and $a_{211}=1$ remain unexcluded.

The 180-second multiplier search retained 13/14 complete blocks, omitting the interrupted $a_{293}$ block. Its 19 additional relations are independent modulo the finite baseline-plus-linear-multiple span, not the full ideal. Degree 3/4 block checks yielded no other vanishing; rebuilding finished within its 180-second bound without closing either chart.

Credit to the repository authors and prior E1/Koszul work, including `fqlx`; prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance for `rbajaj5`. This supplies a reproducible residual search target, not a solve or Lean certificate.
scope: Detailed technical reply expanding existing checked results; no new exclusion, solve PR, or leaderboard credit.
